name: SaaSpo

sources.title: Saaspo on Product Hunt (maker comments about the submit form)

requirements: This is a SaaS website/landing-page DESIGN inspiration gallery, not a product directory - you are nominating a site's design (yours or one you found) to be featured
Submissions are reviewed manually before being featured
preparation: URL of the SaaS website/page whose design you want featured
Direct fetch of saaspo.com/submit returned 403 during research, so confirm the live form fields in a browser
workflow: Fill the submit form (indexed copy: 'Know a great design you think we should feature? Fill out the form below and we'll review it ASAP!')
Submit and optionally follow @saaspo_ on X/Twitter to be notified if featured
watchFor: Site blocks some automated fetches (403) - submit through a normal browser session
Third-party data (submission.directory) lists the link type as nofollow and cost as freemium, so do not expect SEO link equity
Fit matters: this showcases landing-page design quality, so a weak marketing page may be declined even if the product is good
The submit link was deliberately 'hidden in the footer' historically because of spam
countsAsLive: The submitted site appears as a screenshot card in the Saaspo gallery (browsable under page-type filters).
unknowns: Exact form fields (page 403'd to automated fetch)
What the paid/freemium tier buys (third-party listing says 'freemium')
